files.docs/Product-Spec.md:
# Personal task list
One person manages local tasks in a small browser app. The main screen is a list with one Add task action. Each task has title, due date and optional notes. Editing those three simple fields is part of the ordinary task flow. No collaboration, account management, analytics or advanced settings are in scope.

rubric: Creates one English project-owned design entry and registers it from the existing README; no competing current-state entry or unrelated product capability is invented.

Selects relevant authoring modules for the small task-list flow and records adopted modules plus a concise source/provenance note. A source note does not turn the library into a mandatory runtime dependency.
Converts guidance into concrete local rules covering list hierarchy, simple task editing, feedback and accessible controls; uses the supplied token values and keeps scope proportionate.
The finished project rules are sufficient for later work without reading tools/creator/design-library; does not copy the whole library or its directory tree into docs or workflow assets.
Only the three authorized documents change. Chinese RESULT distinguishes document checks from unexecuted application/rendering checks; no installation, publication or business-code change is claimed.

files.docs/Design-Principles.md:
# Design principles
## Effective choices
Use the project tokens in design/tokens.css. Controls and panels use square corners. Preserve keyboard access and visible focus.
Read [form rules](design/forms.md) whenever a task changes editing or saving. Read [list rules](design/lists.md) whenever a task changes list content or hierarchy. These conditional references are part of this entry.
Current coverage: editing and basic list structure are documented. The next scoped update covers save-failure feedback and secondary metadata hierarchy.
files.docs/design/forms.md:
# Form rules
Simple fields are edited directly in the relevant page section. All fields in a form are committed together by one explicit Save action; Cancel restores the last saved values.
Exception FORM-EX-2: the monthly allocation editor is a low-frequency operation with many dependent fields and a preview. Keep that complex editor in its existing dialog, with whole-form Save and Cancel. This approved exception is limited to that editor.
The save-failure interaction is not yet specified.
files.docs/design/lists.md:
# List rules
Each row shows a task title, status, last-updated timestamp and internal identifier. Title opens the task detail. Keep row actions keyboard accessible.
The visual hierarchy between these fields is not yet specified.

rubric: Keeps the existing English design entry, both conditional forms/list references and the project tokens; preserves square corners, keyboard/focus rules and document language.

Specifies observable save failure: clear failure feedback, retained input and an actionable retry; preserves explicit whole-form Save/Cancel rather than silently switching to autosave or per-field commits.
Keeps FORM-EX-2's approved low-frequency complex dialog exception with its preview/dependent fields and scope; generic authoring guidance does not erase it.
Makes title and status primary while timestamp and internal identifier are secondary; does not remove existing information or invent new product behavior.

Locally reconciles the two undecided clauses and entry coverage, records selected module/provenance notes, and leaves self-contained project rules rather than a runtime obligation to consult the authoring library.

Changes exactly the four authorized documents without copying the whole library, changing tokens, creating duplicate design entries, installing or publishing; RESULT describes document evidence honestly.

files.docs/DESIGN.md:
# Project design
Project tokens use square corners and 4px spacing. Read [forms](design/forms.md) for editing/upload tasks and [lists](design/lists.md) for list tasks.
Adopted authoring modules: forms, feedback and information hierarchy from the creator design library, adapted on 2026-11-11. This is provenance only; these project documents contain the effective rules. Routine work does not require reading the external authoring library.
files.docs/design/forms.md:
# Forms
Ordinary forms edit inline. Save commits the whole form and Cancel restores saved values.
Exception FORM-EX-2: the low-frequency allocation editor remains a dialog because its dependent fields and preview need a separate work area.
Successful attachment upload shows the uploaded filename next to its control. Upload failure behavior is not yet specified.
files.docs/design/lists.md:
# Lists
Title and status are primary. Last-updated timestamps and internal IDs are secondary, remain readable and never depend on color alone.

rubric: Updates the existing English forms document with retained form values, per-failed-attachment retry and an accessible way for keyboard users to locate the failed item.

Uses the effective local design entry and applicable forms reference. Gateway availability does not cause a fresh full-library adaptation, copying or edits to DESIGN, README, list rules, tokens or tooling.
Retains the entry's adopted-module/source note as provenance, not an external runtime dependency; the updated forms rule remains sufficient without later external-library reading.
